name: Matar Kebab
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 1½ cups green peas, boiled and coarsely crushed
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each garam masala, chaat masala and cumin
steps: Mix the peas, tofu, besan, onion, chilli, ginger, spices, coriander and salt.
Shape into 8 flat patties and chill for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and cook the patties for 3–4 minutes per side until golden.
note: Peas are a good source of plant protein and fibre; crumbled tofu makes the kebabs firmer.
